description: Agent Water Records: submit a water system record with the facility, operator certification, service connection and sanitary survey records it answers to: the reading moment; the water system with its reference, name, the service connections it states and the operators in responsible charge it names; each facility the system record lists with its id, reference, kind (source, well, treatment_plant, storage, pump_station or distribution) and name; each entry in another system record that names a facility with its id, reference, the record kind, the facility and the moment recorded; each operator certification record with its id, reference, the operator, the grade and the moment it lapses; each service connection record with its id, reference and status (active or inactive); each sanitary survey entry with its id, reference, the facility surveyed, the moment surveyed and the moment the next survey is due. The signed report gives the system record and the records behind it, each facility another record names against the facilities the system record lists, each operator in responsible charge against a certification current at the reading moment, the stated service connection count against the active connection records, and each survey due against a later survey of its facility, and counts them, and names divergent water system records: a facility another system record names that the system record does not list, an operator in responsible charge with no current certification, a service connection count the connection records do not support, and a sanitary survey due with no later survey recorded; then a facility listed twice and a survey entry naming a facility the system record does not list, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No facility list, no certification records beside named operators, or no connection records beside a stated count leaves those points unverified. Facilities, surveys and the system match by letters and digits, so WTP-01 and WTP 01 are one plant, operators by certification reference or name, dates by the day, a certification is current through the day it lapses, an inactive connection is not counted, and a survey due after the reading moment waits. This reads a water utility’s or water system operator’s master record of its system, with operator certifications read as part of it. Verdict water_system_record_divergent, water_system_record_partial, water_system_record_unverified or water_system_record_consistent. POST /api/water-system-record-check. Reads the water records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no system, takes no sample, contacts no regulator, customer or other utility and issues no certification, approval or water right decision, which stay with the utility, its operators and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Water Records reads records held by a water utility or water system operator: water system records with operator certifications, water quality test records from the sampling chain to the results, treatment plant records, discharge monitoring records, meter records, backflow test records and well records, and a water right’s own record, whoever holds it, each against the facility, certification, connection and survey records, the sampling plan, holding times and limits, the operating log, chemical stock and calibrations, the outfalls, discharge limits and monitoring reports, the reading history, the assembly, repair and tester records, the registration, construction and closure records, or the diversions and reported use on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the water system: what the system record lists, what the sampling chain and the treatment log support, what the discharge, meter and backflow records show, and whether the well and water right records hold up; it reads by record holder, not by the water itself: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s irrigation and water-use records against its allocation, the Agent Energy family reads utility bills and tariffs, and the Agent Waste and Recycling Records family reads waste manifests and disposal records, while this family reads the utility’s, the operator’s and the right’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-water-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-water-records/.
